name: Nausika
description: Nausika connects your AI assistant to real maritime data — so when you ask it to plan a passage, find a sheltered anchorage before the wind shifts, check tomorrow's weather window, or estimate fuel for the next leg, you get an answer grounded in actual conditions instead of a confident guess. Covers Mediterranean marinas, ports, anchorages, and bays, with live marine forecasts, tides, and sea-aware routing that respects the coastline. Save your boat profile, favourite spots, and the routes you actually sail.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Nausika to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Nausika to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.nausika.app/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Nausika MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Nausika lists 19 MCP tools, including nausika_marine_forecast, nausika_seasonal_forecast, nausika_tides, nausika_search_places, nausika_get_place, nausika_sea_route, nausika_geocode, nausika_calculator, nausika_describe_place_schema, nausika_is_water, nausika_convert_coordinates, and nausika_manage_boat_profile.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Nausika?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Nausika in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include ChargeHub, Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, and Skimetric.
Nausika requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Nausika is developed by Nausika. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
